questions.knowledge_point: Calculating a Cofactor in a NxN Matrix
questions.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${b}_{34}$, we remove the $3$rd row and the $4$th column: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 & ∗ \\ 1 & 3 & 0 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & -2 \\ -7 & 0 & 0 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{34}=|\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 \\ -7 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${b}_{34}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{34} & =(-1)^{3+4}{M}_{34} \\  & =-{M}_{34} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 \\ -7 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

First, to get the minor of ${g}_{42}$, we remove the $4$th row and $2$nd column: 

$$
G=[\begin{aligned}8 & ∗ & 2 & \sqrt{3} & -2 \\ 3 & ∗ & 0 & \sqrt{7} & 1 \\ 0 & ∗ & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ ∗ & \sqrt{5} & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ 11 & ∗ & 0 & -9 & 11\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{42}=|\begin{aligned}8 & 2 & \sqrt{3} & -2 \\ 3 & 0 & \sqrt{7} & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 11 & 0 & -9 & 11\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${g}_{42}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{42} & =(-1)^{4+2}{M}_{42} \\  & ={M}_{42} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}8 & 2 & \sqrt{3} & -2 \\ 3 & 0 & \sqrt{7} & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 11 & 0 & -9 & 11\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Determinant of a NxN Matrix Using Cofactor Expansion
questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$D=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 6 & 5 & 3 & 0\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(D) & ={d}_{11}{C}_{11}+{d}_{12}{C}_{12}+{d}_{13}{C}_{13}+{d}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =0\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+1\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =1{C}_{14} \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 & ∗ \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & ∗ \\ 6 & 5 & 3 & ∗\end{aligned}| \\  & =1(-1)^{1+4}|\begin{aligned}0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 6 & 5 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =-1(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 5 & 3\end{aligned}|-4\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 6 & 3\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 6 & 5\end{aligned}|) \\  & =-(0-4(3\cdot 0-2\cdot 6)+0) \\  & =-48\end{aligned}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Determinant of a NxN Matrix Using Cofactor Expansion
questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$W=[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & 3 & 6\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(W) & ={w}_{11}{C}_{11}+{w}_{12}{C}_{12}+{w}_{13}{C}_{13}+{w}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =0\cdot {C}_{11}+(-1)\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+2\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =-{C}_{12}+2{C}_{14} \\  & =-1\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & -1 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & ∗ & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & ∗ & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & ∗ & 3 & 6\end{aligned}|+2\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 2 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 & ∗ \\ 3 & 2 & 1 & ∗ \\ 0 & 4 & 3 & ∗\end{aligned}| \\  & =-1\cdot (-1)^{1+2}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 6\end{aligned}|+2\cdot (-1)^{4+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 5 & 0 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 6\end{aligned}|-2|\begin{aligned}0 & 5 & 0 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 3 & 6\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ 0 & 6\end{aligned}|+1\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}|-2(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 4 & 3\end{aligned}|-5\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 0 & 4\end{aligned}|) \\  & =9-2\cdot (-5)\cdot 9 \\  & =9+90 \\  & =99\end{aligned}
$$
